The cloaked warrior remains completely stationary on the rocky cliff throughout the video. He does not fly, jump, walk, or move with the camera. Only the FPV drone camera moves.

Start beside the cloaked warrior on the rocky cliff, very close to his right side, with the drone already moving forward past him. The camera passes the warrior from the side and immediately dives downward over the cliff edge into the misty valley. Keep the warrior behind on the cliff as the drone leaves him and flies away.

The drone descends through clouds and mist, then accelerates forward above waterfalls, bridges, glowing city lights, floating rocks, and deep mountain valleys. Continue toward the distant illuminated kingdom with strong FPV energy, natural speed ramps, immersive motion, and realistic camera momentum.

The camera follows a smooth flowing S-shaped route over the city rooftops, then climbs upward along the massive central crystalline tower. Wrap around the tower in a cinematic spiral, rising toward the glowing summit. At the top, the drone curves around the structure and turns back toward the entire city, ending on a wide heroic view of the glowing kingdom, mountains, sunset clouds, mist, blue energy beams, and floating structures.
